name: self-discovery-ai
description: Движок и прототип AI-сервиса самопознания на 16 координатах

scripts.build: npm run build:content && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/llm/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: node web/scripts/build-copy.mjs && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json && node web/scripts/build-styles.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test engine/dist/*.test.js server/dist/*.test.js server/llm/dist/*.test.js web/dist/*/*.test.js tests/dist/visual/*.test.js tests/dist/a11y/*.test.js tests/dist/e2e/*.test.js tests/dist/load/*.test.js
scripts.snapshots: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/dist/visual/*.test.js
scripts.snapshots:update: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node tests/dist/visual/update.js
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/dist/a11y/*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/dist/e2e/*.test.js
scripts.test:load: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/dist/load/*.test.js
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run lint:content && npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:budget && npm run migrate:check
scripts.migrate:check: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/dist/db/migrate.js check
scripts.restore: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/dist/db/backup.js restore
scripts.clean: rm -rf engine/dist engine/src/generated server/dist server/llm/dist web/dist web/src/generated tests/dist
